answer: On an agent network that monitors a shale quarry, a hundred keys can claim they all saw the dust plume from the terrace. Give each approved sensor one jury seat instead. Verify its manufacturer-signed device ID and a signature over a fresh nonce and the applicant key. Reject a second seat with the same ID. A farm needs one real device per seat. This won't stop wealthy buyers, but creating more keys alone won't create more votes.
